ctx.x: Right, and Buck too. I said, “Gee, Buck, it’s a shame you and I weren’t in contact at that time. He said, “I never thought of it.” He said, “Next edition, I’ll fix it. Don’t worry.” But there was never another edition, and when they put out the paperback, they refused to change anything, because it was too expensive.
